thread:
marie-partnerships: Quick sync for HelixGate listing. They provided a SOC2 PDF and a third-party pen-test. Jordan (SI) will upload artifacts. Need clarification on formats, redaction, and presign TTL. @alan-security @nina-legal

alan-security: Short checklist: SOC2 PDF with scope page, pen-test exec summary (PDF) with counts only, raw scanner exports (Nessus/Trivy/OWASP) via presigned S3, firmware attestation PDF. Redact customer PII and internal IPs in screenshots. Preferred presign TTL: 5 days.

sam-engineering: Ingest policy: use s3://marketplace-evidence/helixgate/<artifact>. Filenames: <partner>_<artifact>_<date>. Include sha256 sidecar file and a metadata.txt with source, scanner, scan-date, sha256. Multipart allowed >100MB. Example presign our side: aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/helixgate/pen-logs/helixgate_pen-logs_2025-04-02.tar.gz --expires-in 432000

nina-legal: Legal needs an executed NDA or a signed handling attestation before raw logs. Public announcement copy must be high-level: "SOC2 audited" and "penetration test performed by [vendor]" only. Evidence retention 12 months by default. I'll DM the addendum template.

jordan-si: Quick Qs: confirm TTL 5 days OK? and do you prefer native scan files or a single tarball? Also is a partner-signed attestation PDF sufficient for firmware, or do you need notarization?

alan-security: TTL 5 days is fine. Native formats preferred; tarball ok for archive. Partner-signed attestation is fine for initial listing, but include whether signing keys are HSM-backed and any cert fingerprints.

marie-partnerships: Plan: SI to upload by Tue AM; security review Tue PM; legal sign-off Wed AM; embargo lift Wed EOD. @deploy-bot hold announcement until legal OKs.

deploy-bot: Hold placed on "helixgate-listing-announcement" until 2025-04-09T23:59:59Z or manual release. Reason: awaiting SOC2/pen evidence and legal sign-off. :robot_face:

jordan-si: Acknowledged, uploading native exports + tarball Tue 08:00 UTC. Thanks team.

marie-partnerships: I'll send the partner a one-pager with exact filenames, NDA link, and presign link when available. :handshake:
